Algeria - Exercise a high degree of caution

Exercise a high degree of caution in Algeria due to the threat of terrorism and the risk of kidnapping.

Border areas - Avoid all travel

Avoid all travel to the following border areas due to the high threat of terrorism, banditry and kidnapping:

  • within 200 km of the border with Mali, Mauritania and Niger
  • within 50 km of the border with Libya
  • within 50 km of the border with Tunisia, except for travel by land to/from Tunisia via the N44 highway and the Oum Tboul border crossing, where you should exercise a high degree of caution

 

Border with Morocco - Avoid all travel

Avoid all travel to the area within 50 km of the border with Morocco due to the increased military presence, the unstable security situation and the difficulty of finding the border’s exact location.
